import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAXN = 8;
    static final int MAXSZ = 1048576 + 5;
    
    static int add(int a, int b) {
        return (a + b >= MOD) ? (a + b - MOD) : (a + b);
    }
    
    static int sub(int a, int b) {
        return (a >= b) ? (a - b) : (a + MOD - b);
    }
    
    static int mul(int a, int b) {
        return (int)(((long)a * b) % MOD);
    }
    
    static void addto(int[] x, int idx, int y) {
        x[idx] = add(x[idx], y);
    }
    
    static int modpow(int base, int exp) {
        int res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = mul(res, base);
            base = mul(base, base);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
    
    static int n;
    static int[][] prob = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] match = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][][] permMask = new int[7][7][7];
    static int fullMask;
    static int answer;
    static int[] dpTable = new int[MAXSZ];
    
    static boolean matches(int x, int y, int z) {
        int[] arr = {0, x, y, z};
        int[] idx = {0, 1, 2, 3};
        do {
            boolean ok = true;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 3; ++i) {
                if (match[idx[i]][arr[i]] == 0) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (ok) return true;
        } while (nextPermutation(idx, 1, 3));
        return false;
    }
    
    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] array, int start, int end) {
        int i = end;
        while (i > start && array[i - 1] >= array[i]) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i <= start) {
            return false;
        }
        int j = end;
        while (array[j] <= array[i - 1]) {
            j--;
        }
        int temp = array[i - 1];
        array[i - 1] = array[j];
        array[j] = temp;
        j = end;
        while (i < j) {
            temp = array[i];
            array[i] = array[j];
            array[j] = temp;
            i++;
            j--;
        }
        return true;
    }
    
    static void dfsForward(int curVal, int row, int col) {
        boolean[] used = new boolean[7];
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) used[i] = false;
        used[0] = true;
        for (int i = 1; i < 7; i++) used[i] = true;
        
        if (curVal == 0) return;
        
        if (row == 4) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i) used[i] = true;
            int state = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; ++j) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; ++k) {
                        if (matches(i, j, k)) {
                            int a = -1, b = -1, c = -1;
                            used[i] = used[j] = used[k] = false;
                            for (int l = 1; l <= 6; ++l) {
                                if (!used[l]) {
                                    if (a == -1) a = l;
                                    else if (b == -1) b = l;
                                    else c = l;
                                }
                            }
                            used[i] = used[j] = used[k] = true;
                            if (c != -1) state |= permMask[a][b][c];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            addto(dpTable, state, curVal);
            return;
        }
        
        match[row][col] = 1;
        int nextVal = mul(curVal, prob[row][col]);
        if (col == 6) dfsForward(nextVal, row + 1, 1);
        else dfsForward(nextVal, row, col + 1);
        
        match[row][col] = 0;
        nextVal = mul(curVal, sub(1, prob[row][col]));
        if (col == 6) dfsForward(nextVal, row + 1, 1);
        else dfsForward(nextVal, row, col + 1);
    }
    
    static void dfsBackward(int curVal, int row, int col) {
        if (curVal == 0) return;
        
        if (row == 7) {
            int state = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; ++j) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; ++k) {
                        if (matches(i, j, k)) state |= permMask[i][j][k];
                    }
                }
            }
            addto(dpTable, fullMask ^ state, mul(curVal, dpTable[fullMask ^ state]));
            answer = add(answer, mul(curVal, dpTable[fullMask ^ state]));
            return;
        }
        
        match[row - 3][col] = 1;
        int nextVal = mul(curVal, prob[row][col]);
        if (col == 6) dfsBackward(nextVal, row + 1, 1);
        else dfsBackward(nextVal, row, col + 1);
        
        match[row - 3][col] = 0;
        nextVal = mul(curVal, sub(1, prob[row][col]));
        if (col == 6) dfsBackward(nextVal, row + 1, 1);
        else dfsBackward(nextVal, row, col + 1);
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        int inv100 = modpow(100, MOD - 2);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                int x = sc.nextInt();
                prob[i][j] = mul(x, inv100);
            }
        }
        for (int i = n + 1; i <= 6; ++i) prob[i][i] = 1;
        
        int cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; ++j) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; ++k) {
                    permMask[i][j][k] = 1 << cnt;
                    ++cnt;
                }
            }
        }
        fullMask = (1 << cnt) - 1;
        
        dfsForward(1, 1, 1);
        
        for (int j = 0; j < cnt; ++j) {
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << cnt); ++i) {
                if ((i & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                    addto(dpTable, i, dpTable[i ^ (1 << j)]);
                }
            }
        }
        
        answer = 0;
        dfsBackward(1, 4, 1);
        answer = sub(1, answer);
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
